title: Customizable crystalline-amorphous rectifying heterostructure cathodes for durable and super-fast zinc storage
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,4651-4664
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE00304K, Paper
Ming Yang, Mingyan Chuai, Mengnan Lai, Jianhui Zhu, Yanyi Wang, Qicheng Hu, Minfeng Chen, Jizhang Chen, Kang Fang, Guoliang Chai, Hongwei Mi, Lingna Sun, Chuanxin He, Dingtao Ma, Peixin Zhang
This work provides a feasible pathway starting from robust material customization for the controlled phase transition of a crystalline–amorphous heterostructure to achieve superior performance in aqueous zinc-ion batteries.
